title: Restoring Payments by Wire — Paystride Payroll Card Program Funding Account
content:
A restoring payment brings the funding balance of a Paystride Payroll Card Program back up to its restoration reserve, whether the program is live after a regular batch left the balance short or suspended after a returned funding payment, and it is figured only for a program whose funding balance is below that reserve.

## Who makes it

The restoring payment is the employer's own act: the authorized employer contact sends it by wire from the employer's own bank account once the desk has stated its amount, the desk never sends it for the employer, and a program whose package does not allow wire funding cannot make one.

## When its amount is worked out

The restoring payment is worked out only after the funding ledger carries the late funding fee owed for every regular payroll batch whose funds arrived after its funding deadline.

Put the other way, while any regular payroll batch whose funds arrived after its funding deadline still lacks the late funding fee owed on it in the funding ledger, no restoring payment amount is stated.

## Sending the wire

The wire is sent with `send_restoring_wire_ac37b9e9`, a tool the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it and hands it over to the authorized employer contact, who sends the wire. The desk does not run it.

**Effect.** The wire is received at once: one funding receipt is added to the program's funding account history with the funding method wire, today's date and the current Eastern Time of receipt, tied to no pay date, and the program's funding balance rises by the amount sent. The employer contact sees the receipt reference and the new funding balance; nothing else on the program changes.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `paycard_program_id` | the reference number of the employer's Payroll Card Program that receives the wire, as returned by the program lookup for this employer | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the amount of the wire in US dollars | a positive number with 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half up to the cent before it is booked |

### Return

- A line beginning "Wire received" indicates the wire was booked. It names the funding receipt reference (a text identifier), the amount received (US dollars, two decimal places), the receipt date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (HH:MM Eastern Time), and the program's funding balance after the wire (US dollars, two decimal places).
- A line beginning "No wire sent" reports an amount that, rounded to the cent, is not a positive figure; nothing is booked.

### Illustration of the contract (hypothetical)

Called with `amount_usd` of 1302.456, the wire is booked as 1302.46, and the returned line shows the funding balance after the wire. Called with an amount of 0.00, the line begins "No wire sent".
